notes:
- Cleaner launcher and integrated features.
- Custom Name and online chat fixed.
- F2 recovery and overlay dragging improved.
- Platform input bindings restored.
changelogNotes:
- Reorganized the launcher into Launch, Profile, Settings, Player Profile, Custom Content, Car and Plugins, keeping live overlay controls in the F2 menu.
- Integrated Custom Cars, Ball Speed, FPS, Spotify, keyboard/mouse and controller overlays into BondoMod. Optional plugins remain available separately.
- Added custom banners with a centered crop preview and moved Custom Cars into Custom Content. Menu background changes remain unavailable while development continues.
- Restored Custom Name in matches. Plus users can enable server-visible names; local names remain available separately. Fixed team names being changed and the account lookup that prevented text chat from opening.
- Fixed the overlay position editor, added an independent Done control and retained saved positions. Overlays follow Rocket League's running state without losing their enabled settings.
- Simplified overlay controls and restored keyboard/mouse and controller binding recording for Platform Display.
- Improved transparent F2 menu rendering, focus handling and recovery. Added a Windows desktop rendering check covering repeated opening and closing.
- Added taillight colour controls and preserved existing live Car customisation settings.
- Removed retired plugin entries and kept local titles, items and presets available through the integrated menu.
